population.text: 71 patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) TKD mutations who had received at least one line of prior systemic therapy (all had prior platinum-based chemotherapy)

citations.quote: The primary efficacy population considered by FDA comprises 71 patients with unresectable or metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC with *HER2* TKD mutations who had received at least one line of prior systemic therapy and received zongertinib 120 mg orally QD in Beamion LUNG-1.
All had received prior platinum-based chemotherapy and 78% had received previous treatment with an anti-PD-1/anti-PD-L1 antibody

endpoint.text: Objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR) per RECIST v1.1 by blinded independent central review

citations.quote: The major efficacy outcome measures were objective response rate (ORR) and duration of response (DOR) by Response Evaluation Criteria in Solid Tumors (RECIST) version 1.1 as assessed by blinded independent central review (BICR).
The efficacy population included 71 patients with unresectable or metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) mutations based on prospective local testing.

indication.text: Adult patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and who have received prior systemic therapy

citations.quote: HERNEXEOS is indicated for the treatment of adult patients with unresectable or metastatic non-squamous non-small cell lung cancer (NSCLC) whose tumors have HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations, as detected by an FDA-approved test, and who have received prior systemic therapy [see *Dosage and Administration* (2.1)].

target_moa.text: Small molecule kinase inhibitor of HER2 (ERBB2); inhibits HER2 phosphorylation and downstream signaling and proliferation of lung cancer cells harboring HER2 TKD activating mutations

citations.quote: Zongertinib (HERNEXEOS) is a small molecule kinase inhibitor of human epidermal growth factor receptor 2 (HER2, also known as Erb-B2 receptor tyrosine kinase 2 [ERBB2]), including wild-type HER2 and HER2 activating mutations.

In vitro, zongertinib inhibited phosphorylation of HER2, downstream signaling of HER2 (phosphorylation of ERK), and proliferation of lung cancer cells harboring HER2 tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations.
The established pharmacological class for zongertinib is kinase inhibitor.

key_safety.text: Most common (> 20%) adverse reactions: diarrhea (53%), hepatotoxicity (27%), rash (27%), fatigue (22%), nausea (21%). Serious adverse reactions in 34%; fatal reactions in 1% (due to pneumonia). Warnings: hepatotoxicity, left ventricular dysfunction, ILD/pneumonitis.

citations.quote: In this pooled safety population, the most common (> 20%) adverse reactions were diarrhea (53%), hepatotoxicity (27%), rash (27%), fatigue (22%), and nausea (21%).
Serious adverse reactions occurred in 34% of patients receiving HERNEXEOS.
Fatal adverse reactions occurred in 1% of patients who received HERNEXEOS, due to pneumonia.

- Hepatotoxicity [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.1)]
- Left Ventricular Dysfunction [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.2)]
- Interstitial Lung Disease/Pneumonitis [see *Warnings and Precautions* (5.3)]

detail.text: No REMS required; safety concerns adequately addressed in labeling

citations.quote: There were no significant safety concerns identified during the NDA review requiring risk management beyond labeling or warranting a consideration for a REMS.

detail.text: Patient selection requires HER2 (ERBB2) TKD activating mutations detected by an FDA-approved test; enrollment in Beamion LUNG-1 was based on prospective local testing, with the Oncomine Dx Target Test used only for retrospective testing of 52% (37/71) of samples

citations.quote: Select patients for treatment of unresectable or metastatic NSCLC based on the presence of HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations in tumor specimens [see *Clinical Studies* (14)]. Information on FDA-approved tests for HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain activating mutations is available at: http://www.fda.gov/CompanionDiagnostics.

The efficacy population included 71 patients with unresectable or metastatic, non-squamous NSCLC with HER2 (ERBB2) tyrosine kinase domain (TKD) mutations based on prospective local testing. Of those, tumor tissue samples from 52% (37/71) of patients were retrospectively tested using Oncomine™ Dx Target Test (Life Technologies Corporation, Tissue-test).

vote.text: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee as no significant efficacy or safety issues required external input

citations.quote: FDA did not refer this application to an advisory committee or seek input from other external consultants as no significant efficacy or safety issues were identified during the review that required external input and the application did not raise significant public health questions regarding the role of zongertinib for the proposed indication.
